title: 2 More Tied to Rochester Restaurant Plead Guilty in Fraud Scandal
notes: Does not state exact plea dates for either defendant, only that pleas had been entered by this article's February 7, 2025 publication date.
supports: Mustafa Jama, 48, of Rochester, and Asha Jama, 42, of Lakeville, entered guilty pleas to federal money laundering charges, reported as of February 7, 2025.

Both were accused of conspiring to establish shell companies to receive and distribute Federal Child Nutrition Program funds, with approximately $1.5 million in misappropriated funds linked to Brava Restaurant used for personal expenses.
does_not_support: The exact date either defendant entered their plea; only that it had occurred by the February 7, 2025 publication date.
Any sentencing outcome for either defendant.
